stem_book: Consider a block and trolley system as shown in figure (a 20 kg trolley on a horizontal surface, joined by a string over a pulley at the table edge to a hanging 6 kg block of weight 60 N). If the coefficient of kinetic friction between the trolley and the surface is 0.04, the acceleration of the system in m s⁻² is: (Consider that the string is massless and unstretchable and the pulley is also massless and frictionless; g = 10 m/s²) (a) 3 (b) 4 (c) 2 (d) 1.2
